system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
i wish has a feature to switch on notifications for your fav artists for us know whenever they put out new music as soon as possible

PREDICTED INTENT: feature_request_feedback

PRECEDENTS:

[1884366] (similarity 0.72, intent feature_request_feedback)
  past customer: can there be some kind notification system for new releases @ artists you follow like in Release Radar isnt best way
  spotify replied: Hey! We're no longer sending emails for every new release. Head to Browse > New Releases to find the latest tracks updated every Friday

[1780926] (similarity 0.65, intent feature_request_feedback)
  past customer: i have an idea for a new feature, how about a "Play Next" button for songs, that'll be pretty neato
  spotify replied: Hey! We can see how that'd be useful. Suggest it in our Community where you can get support from other fans: <link>

[2639842] (similarity 0.64, intent feature_request_feedback)
  past customer: hey please add a #macOS notification for when a new song starts like what does <link>
  spotify replied: Thanks for your suggestion! We'll let our devs know it's something you'd like to see. We'd also recommend showing your support for the official idea here: <link>

[930007] (similarity 0.63, intent feature_request_feedback)
  past customer: please make a feature that allows you to filter out live versions of songs when you are listening to an artist 💕
  spotify replied: This sounds like a great idea! Suggest it in our Community at <link> and get support from other users

[292966] (similarity 0.63, intent feature_request_feedback)
  past customer: add a feature where we can see our most played songs and artists pleeeasseeeeee
  spotify replied: Hey Matt, we can see how that'd be useful! You can vote for the official idea here: <link>
